title: Add Back navigation across VAT calculator flow steps

requirements.summary: Ensure every calculator step exposes a visible Back action that navigates to the immediately previous step while preserving in-flow state and using the shared Button styling.
acceptanceCriteria: On /calculator, each step in the multi-step flow (Select Country, Transaction Details, VAT Results, Explanation, Invoice Preview) provides a Back action that returns to the immediately previous step in the flow.
The Back action uses the existing step state so that when returning to a prior step, previously selected/entered values are still shown (no loss of form selections due to navigation).
The Back button label is in English and consistently styled with existing buttons (using the shared Button component).

file_operations.description: Wire Back navigation into every step render by passing the existing handleBack callback to steps that currently lack it, and ensure step transitions use currentStep decrement (no state reset) so previously entered selections remain visible when navigating back.

Add a visible Back button (using the shared Button component) to the Select Country step UI and call an injected onBack handler so the flow can navigate to the previous step/location without clearing selection state.

Add Back/Continue navigation controls (using the shared Button component) to the Explanation step UI, driven by injected onBack/onNext callbacks, without altering the existing explanation/tabs/paywall behavior.

requirements.summary: Add Back navigation specifically to Select Country and Explanation steps, integrating them with CalculatorFlowPage step navigation (including Back-to-home behavior from the initial step and Back/Continue actions on Explanation).
acceptanceCriteria: The “Select Country” step UI includes a Back button that returns the user to the previous location (or, if there is no prior step, navigates back to the app home/landing route) without breaking the flow.
The “Explanation” step UI includes both Back and Continue actions: Back returns to “VAT Results”; Continue advances to “Invoice Preview”.
CalculatorFlowPage step transitions remain consistent (i.e., no step skipping, and currentStep updates correctly when using Back/Continue).

file_operations.description: Update step wiring so: (1) CountrySelectionStep receives an onBack that invokes the existing handleBack logic (which navigates to '/' when currentStep is 0), and (2) ExplainVatPanel receives onBack (to return to VAT Results) and onNext/Continue (to advance to Invoice Preview) via the existing handleBack/handleNext logic, keeping currentStep consistent.
Extend props to accept onBack and render a Back button that triggers it; ensure UI placement does not interfere with country selection controls.
Extend props to accept onBack and onNext, and render a Back button (goes to VAT Results) plus a Continue button (goes to Invoice Preview) in addition to the existing Export PDF control.
